objective: Implement M1a of the project-context PRD: wire frozen memory into the daemon task path (FR-7), build the layered project-instruction read engine with repo-root discovery and /context (FR-1), and land the minimal real children executor with read-only scout subagents plus concurrency/nesting gates (FR-8 step one).
end_state: A task created by the desktop carries a once-frozen memory snapshot in its TaskContract that every later attempt/run inherits and the daemon records in a V1Store injection ledger; native runs inject layered project instructions (global ~/.r-code/context.md, repo foreign AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md fallback, repo .r-code/context.md, subdir JIT) within budgets, never evicting frozen layers, with /context showing exactly what was injected on GUI and TUI; the main agent can spawn real read-only scout children through host catalog tools children_spawn/wait/close that queue past the concurrency bound, refuse nesting, block in wait without busy polling, and return summaries; the Appendix-A baseline has been captured for both arms of groups A/B and the M1a verdict recorded.
non_goals: Codex-route host-side compaction of any kind (PRD 2.2: Codex model traffic never passes the host; /compact passthrough is M2)
Any write to project files outside the proposal boundary; foreign instruction files are strictly read-only (PRD 6.1-6.2)
Private state inside the project directory: all private state stays in AppData-side data roots (PRD 6.1)
FR-8 step two: delegation contract polish, the full three-part return payload, and WorkUnit sub-run context upgrade (M1b)
FR-2 /init engine, FR-3 doc-sync hooks, FR-4 invariants, FR-5 team artifacts (later milestones)
Any new numbered legacy-store migration: new daemon tables go to the string-keyed v1_schema_migrations ledger only
git commits/pushes: work coexists uncommitted on the tree per house discipline

environment.notes: Baseline inherited from O-GATE 8/8 KEEP (all uncommitted on the tree): house 155 test-result lines with the single declared red = r-code-store plan_schema 18-vs-35. Any new failure beyond that pair blocks KEEP. Verification per task: cargo fmt --all --check; cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings (note: pre-existing O-GATE lint debt in e08/e09r/e10/s22/tui-engine was already cleaned in task M1a-00); cargo test --workspace --all-features; npm --prefix src-tauri/frontend test. This host shows an rustc ICE on stale incremental caches in full-workspace test runs — use CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 for the big suite. File gates are tight on run_manager.rs (~1661) and application.rs (~1979): new logic lands in new modules (services/project_instructions.rs, services/children_executor.rs) with delegation, not inline growth.

tasks.title: Instruction engine core (discovery/layering/budgets)
tasks.description: New services/project_instructions.rs: repo-root discovery (ancestor .git walk; .git file -> gitdir/common-dir resolution, main+worktree roots nearest-first; no .git -> workspace root flagged); layer collection (global ~/.r-code/context.md; repo foreign AGENTS.md with configurable fallback list default [CLAUDE.md], case-insensitive per 6.7; repo own .r-code/context.md; subdir AGENTS.md for JIT); content-hash dedup; >4MiB skip; 32KiB total budget with inverse trim order global-first; JIT 8KiB allowance; BOM/EOL normalization for hashing (6.7). Pure decision functions + thin fs loader, mirroring tools_search WalkBuilder settings where scanning.

files.what: Engine: types (InstructionBundle, InstructionEntry{layer,path,sha256,bytes,status}), discovery, collection, budget planner.

acceptance_criteria: Repo-root: plain repo, linked worktree (.git file) yielding main-root + worktree-root with nearest-wins, and no-git fallback are all unit-pinned with temp fixtures.
Foreign fallback order AGENTS.md > CLAUDE.md; CLAUDE.local.md never injected; non-standard names only via explicit config.
Conflict/dedup: same-content entries collapse; .r-code/ entries win ordering slots after foreign (later-wins composition).
Budget: oversize file skipped with status; over-budget bundle trims global layer first and marks entries trimmed; JIT allowance separate and droppable.
Windows: matching is case-insensitive; hashing normalizes BOM/CRLF.

tasks.title: ChildrenSupervisor real semantics (close/counter/gates/wait primitive)
tasks.description: kernel children.rs: monotonic next_seq counter (close-safe ids), close(child_task_id) removing the entry, concurrency gate (live count vs configurable bound, default 6; over-bound spawns return a queued outcome or are refused per config), nesting depth (default 1) checked next to the rank ceiling, and a notify-based blocking wait primitive replacing the immediate-error path (timeout honored).

files.what: Counter, close, gates, wait primitive (tokio Notify or condvar abstraction consistent with kernel's std-only style).

acceptance_criteria: close removes the entry; a subsequent spawn never reuses an id (monotonic counter pinned by test).
7th spawn with bound 6 does not run concurrently; queued spawn executes after a slot frees (or is refused when configured to reject).
Nested spawn beyond depth 1 is rejected with a typed error.
wait blocks without spinning (elapsed/iterations asserted, notify wakes on complete).
